nom: Vichy LiftActiv B3 Tone Correcting Cream, Night with Retinol

avis.texte: Emollient enriched, so an additional moisturizer isn't needed just use alone at night and whalha! Follow the manufacturer's phase 1-3 directions if you have sensitive skin. Visibly noticed a reduction in wrinkles in a week.

This anti-aging face cream is truly impressive! Since I started using it, my skin feels firmer, smoother, and more radiant. Fine lines and wrinkles have noticeably softened, and my complexion looks refreshed and youthful. The cream is rich but absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy residue—just a healthy, hydrated glow. I love that it contains powerful ingredients like hyaluronic acid and antioxidants that nourish and protect my skin throughout the day. It’s become a key part of my skincare routine, and I’m excited to see continued improvements. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to fight signs of aging and maintain a youthful complexion!

I’ve been using the Vichy Pure Retinol Night Cream for several years and I’ve noticed a visible improvement in my skin’s texture and overall appearance. My skin feels smoother, looks more radiant, and some of my fine lines appear less noticeable. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin, so I introduced it gradually, using it a few nights a week at first. The formula feels lightweight and absorbs well without leaving a greasy residue. I experienced mild dryness during the first few weeks, but using a good moisturizer helped. What I like most is that it delivers the benefits of retinol without causing significant irritation. With consistent use, my skin looks clearer, more even-toned, and refreshed each morning. Overall, it’s a great addition to my nighttime skincare routine and worth considering if you’re looking for an effective retinol product.

Vichy's B3 Tone Correcting night cream has a mild, light fragrance that I did not find to be too strong or overwhelming. The cream looks thick but is easily applied and absorbs rather quickly into my skin. It gave my skin a matte finish look and very smooth to the touch with no sticky or tacky residue feeling. The next morning, my face did not feel oily, greasy, or heavy and no irritation from using this cream was experienced for me. There are directions listed on the box that suggests using this night cream 2 nights for the first week and then every other night for the second week, followed by nightly in the third week if your skin can tolerate it. So far I have not experienced any ill effects on my skin from using but those with more sensitive skin types may need to follow the recommendation or adjust for a slower escalation as tolerated. I haven't noticed any difference in my skin so far but I'm sure, as with any cream, it takes time.

As I'm entering my 40's, I'm beginning to look for skincare products with anti-aging benefits like retinol. So far, Vichy Liftactiv is a great starter for a night routine. I applied a thin layer before bed, and when I woke up, I noticed my skin looked brighter and more even-toned. Some things I dislike about this cream is that while absorbent, it's also quite sticky. I was aware of my sticky face when my head was on the pillow, and my hair was sticking to my skin. I also don't understand why it's advertised as being fragrance free when it has a strong floral smell. It doesn't bother me very much, but I think people who look for hypoallergenic and fragrance free products should be aware. I would recommend it, but suggest to use conservatively until their skin gets adjusted.

avis.titre: Rich night cream with good ingredients that I am enjoying so far.
avis.texte: This Vichy night cream is intended to be used on an increasing schedule starting with twice a week and building up the nightly frequency. Contains retinol, niacinamide and a probiotics. I look forward to continued use in anticipation of positive results. It’s rich and feels moisturizing with initial uses and I like it. I will be following the recommended schedule since I have skin that leans to the dry side and want to make sure of the frequency I use it because some of the ingredients can be drying for me. It’s alcohol free and dermatology tested. States fragrance free but it has pleasant light scent.
